summary: n8n-nodes-devops-utils postinstall beacons installer hostname to hardcoded bare IP
details: Package advertises itself as an n8n community node but ships no functional node code (empty main, empty nodes). The package.json postinstall script fans out five network probes to the hardcoded bare IP 103.27.109.184 (port 9999 over HTTP via node http.get, curl, wget, and python3 urllib; port 8888 via netcat). One of the probes is a python3 one-liner that reads the installer's hostname via `popen('hostname')` and embeds it into the request URL (`http://103.27.109.184:9999/pwned-py3-<hostname>`), transmitting the installer's host identifier to the attacker-controlled endpoint at install time. The multi-channel probing to a bare-IP C2 endpoint on `npm install`, combined with the absence of any legitimate package functionality, is install-time exfiltration and a callback beacon impersonating a legitimate n8n community node.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
